programme.title: Astrud Gilberto & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: Gilberto, Gillespie & Skymasters - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, Dutch big band The Skymasters accompanied monumental jazz trumpet legend Dizzy Gillespie and the Brazilian bossa nova singer Astrud Gilberto at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Michael Mossman
programme.sub-title: Munich Philharmonic Hall: Michel Camilo Quintet
programme.desc: Well-known for his exuberant style and intimate familiarity with a vast range of jazz and Latin idioms, Michel Camilo has always had a sixth sense for musical adventure. Camilo was one of the most stimulating jazz pianists to emerge in the mid- to late '80s. His powerful two-handed attack (full of impressive technical skills), his knowledge of both jazz and Afro-Cuban music, and his willingness to constantly take chances turn each of his solos into an adventure. This broadcast was taped during the 1991 Münchner Klaviersommer, when Camilo was playing with his amazing Quintet. He is accompanied by Ned Mann (bass), Cliff Almond (drums), Michel Mossman (trumpet and trombone) and Ralph Bowen (saxophone and flute). Camilo's rise to fame has been swift, and his influences range from jazz musicians like Art Tatum and Keith Jarrett to twentieth-century composers like Debussy and Ravel.

programme.title: Ted Curson
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Don Cherry, Peter Apfelbaum, Bo Freeman & Joshua Jones
programme.desc: Trumpeter Don Cherry was a musician of great versatility, creating an endless variety of styles and influencing generations of musicians. Multikulti presents a never-before heard mixture of international sounds, from mainstream jazz to reggae, in his first collaboration with the amazing Peter Apfelbaum, one of the most in-demand performers at jazz festivals all over the world.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival. Zawinul performed on a huge synthesizer outfit in this concert, recorded live at the Kongressaal in Munich, Germany.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6 and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Jihye Kim, Johan Karlström & Christine Nonbo Andersen
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2019.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Johnny Cash
programme.desc: Johnny Cash was one of the most influential figures in American music in the post war period. He managed to combine elements of folk, rock 'n' roll and country, which together with his distinctive voice and guitar style, created an instantly recognisable sound. 1994 was to prove to be Cash's only appearance at the Montreux Festival. The "Man In Black" had just released his acclaimed American Recordings album and his European tour took in Montreux on July 5. This classic concert features a number of tracks from his new album coupled with favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk The Line, Ghost Riders In The Sky, Orange Blossom Special and San Quentin. An added bonus is the guest appearance of his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks. Caught at one of the high points of his distinguished career this is truly Johnny Cash at his best.

programme.title: Carlos Santana
programme.desc: With a momentous career stretching back into the sixties, Santana has led the way in introducing initially Latin rhythms and styles and later influences from worldly cultures into the world of mainstream rock music. Along the way they have collected numerous awards, accrued multi-million album sales and garnered a string of top hit singles. Masterfully filmed in Montreux, Switzerland in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classic tracks from early hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" through to their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". This is undoubtedly the have-to-have definitive Santana live concert. Music video by Carlos Santana __© 2011 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland
programme.desc: Flying Over Iceland: Part I is a stunning yet soothing aerial journey to the remote fjiords and valleys of eastern Iceland. The first of a series of 1 hour films, Part I begins at sunrise on a perfect summer day in Breiðdalsvík, where a golden sun lights up the majestic valley. After soaring through the golden sea mists and offering a glimpse of the stunning Breiðdalur Valley (its name means ‘Wide Valley'), viewers then head inland to a hidden, magical arched waterfall for a refreshing immersive flight that begins at the base of the falls and reaches above the clouds. Next, as the morning turns into a sunlit afternoon, viewers are swept inland to the crystal clear waters of the the impressive Breiðdalsá river, to cool off in some falls along with a pair of local swans. Well known for salmon fishing, the turquoise blue river winds its way scenically across the valley basin to the sea, which is where the film ends - but not before a chance encounter with a local reindeer! The final flight in Part 1 offers a sunny afternoon look at the tiny village of Breiðdalsvík from afar and offers amazing blue water vistas of with green islands, seagulls, a rock island that that looks like a cat, a scenic lighthouse, and more.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: For 19-year-old Jay (Maika Monroe), the fall should be about school, boys and weekends out at the lake. But after a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, she finds herself plagued by strange visions and the inescapable sense that someone, or something, is following her. Faced with this burden, Jay and her teenage friends must find a way to escape the horrors that seem to be only a few steps behind.

programme.title: We Still Kill The Old Way (2014)
programme.desc: When retired East End villain Charlie Archer is murdered by a feral street gang, his brother Ritchie returns to London from Spain to investigate. With the police investigation drawing blank after blank, Ritchie decides to take the law into his own hands and bring his old school justice back to the streets of East London. Rounding up his old firm, he leads a vigilante crusade against the vicious young criminals, using every grizzly method at his disposal to find and punish his brother's killers. They're outgunned and outnumbered, but this firm has never been outclassed yet!

programme.title: The Furies

programme.title: Freehold
programme.desc: Twisted and highly sinister. Hussein, a young amoral London estate agent will do anything to get his commission. His life takes a dramatic turn when he is tormented by an angry ex-client, Orlan (Javier Botet: It) who has claimed Hussein's flat as his, unbeknownst to the estate agent.

programme.title: Lowlife
programme.desc: What happens when you throw together a fallen Mexican wrestler with serious rage issues, a just-out-of-prison ex-con with a regrettable face tattoo, and a recovering junkie motel owner in search of a kidney? That's the premise of the berserk, blood-spattered, and wickedly entertaining feature debut from Ryan Prows.

programme.title: Three Musketeers
programme.desc: France is in turmoil and a new, naive King finds himself manipulated by the evil Cardinal Richelieu (James Cosmo). With a corrupt commander of the royal guard by his side the Cardinal employs the expertise of the wicked Milady de Winter in a plot to bring down the monarchy. programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: The Christmas Cure
programme.desc: When Vanessa returns home for Christmas, her name comes up for a huge promotion back at work! She is torn between taking the job or staying home to take over the family clinic, while her visit has rekindled an old romance as well.

programme.title: An Evergreen Christmas
programme.desc: Evie Lee returns to her hometown for her father's funeral, facing family debt and tough choices between her music career and saving the family's tree farm.

programme.title: The Christmas Gift
programme.desc: Inspired by a true story. Ten-year-old Wesley puts together a "Secret Santa" gift for a needy child and when ten-year-old Megan opens the package, she discovers an item that will have a huge impact on her life to come.

programme.title: A Song for Christmas
programme.desc: Two single parents stumble into the possibility of love for Christmas, only to discover that their daughters are embroiled in a rivalry at school. When the rivalry gets out of control, can hope and healing lead everyone to a peaceful and merry Christmas?

programme.title: Moving McAllister
programme.desc: Rick Robinson is a ladder-climbing law intern from Miami with four days until the Bar Exam. Desperate to score points with his boss (McAllister), he commits to a favor he can't afford. He ends up in a rundown truck headed to L.A. with his boss's possessions, his Hollywood-bound niece, and her pet pig. Amidst hitch-hikers, breakdowns, and assorted local yokels, Rick finds love, life and maybe himself in this trans-American road trip from hell.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God's protection and Derek's assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek's own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: Attempting to connect with the woman he has begun to love, Adam offers to bring Persephone's brother to Falstone, as well as host a ball. He wants Falstone Castle to feel like home to Persephone. The tender affection growing between them gives Persephone hope, but she cannot seem to get past the walls he has built around his heart.

programme.title: Love's Sweet Recipe
programme.desc: Courtney is a chef who runs her family's restaurant. Armed with a family heirloom her father left behind called the "Rule Book of Love" to guide the way. Handsome Jake is there to help, and she finds love in a place she least expected.

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: To save her destitute family, Persephone Lancaster accepts a marriage proposal from Adam Boyce, the mysterious Duke of Kielder, the most feared man in the kingdom. Isolated in the duke's foreboding castle, Persephone searches for what happiness she can find. But Adam's determination to keep his new bride at a distance makes a future between them precarious.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: When Sarah Goldman, a lovely young school teacher in Chicago, wants to please her parents, she invents a boyfriend whom she believes will be the man of her mother's dreams. When her parents insist on meeting the man, Sarah hires Bob, an actor, to pretend to be her "beau". The masquerade works flawlessly for a time and brings comic situations, but in the end, their lives are irrevocably changed.

programme.desc: A former colleague seeks Vicki's help to find out what kind of creature is now in possession of his body.

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: After eating from the Tree of Knowledge, a primitive villager/slacker flees his people and encounters murderous Cain, slave traders, charismatic nutcase Abraham, and finally the city of Sodom. There the man falls for a princess, is hailed as "the chosen" by the oppressed people and ultimately leads a revolt that topples the government and frees the slaves. He heads off with the princess to visit Egypt....

programme.title: Pineapple Express
programme.desc: Process Server Dale Denton has a grudging business relationship with the laconic Saul Silver, deigning to visit only to purchase Saul's primo product, a rare new strain of pot called Pineapple Express. But when Dale becomes the only witness to a murder by a crooked cop and the city's most dangerous drug lord, he panics and dumps the Pineapple Express at the scene. When it's traced back to him, Dale and Saul run for their lives and they quickly discover that they're not just suffering from weed-fueled paranoia. If they survive, these two just might become real friends.

programme.title: Guarding Tess
programme.desc: A beloved but cantankerous former First Lady engages in a battle of wills with her bodyguard.

programme.title: Oily To Bed, Oily To Rise
programme.desc: The Stooges are tramps looking for handouts. Although the boys are down and out, Curly seems to get everything he wishes for. After some trouble with a farmer, the boys come across an abandoned car, one of Curly's wishes. The car actually belongs to some con men who have just gypped the widow Jenkins out of her land. The boys wind up at the Mrs. Jenkins house just in time for a free meal. To repay Mrs. Jenkins the boys try to fix her well and instead unleash an oil geyser. Learning that Mrs. Jenkins has been swindled, the boys go to retrieve the deed before it can be recorded. They find the bad guys and after a wild fight recover the deed. The boys return the deed to Mrs. Jenkins and marry her daughters April, May and June.

programme.title: Grown Ups

programme.title: Derek's Dead
programme.desc: Two former best friends (who currently hate each other) are forced to reconnect when their third former best friend (who they also hate) tasks them with spreading his ashes. There's only one problem: they couldn't care less.

programme.title: You, Me and Him
programme.desc: At 40, Olivia is a career-driven lawyer in a stable relationship with her younger girlfriend, Alex. Happy at home and at work, Olivia has no interest in children - at least until she finds herself sobbing uncon­trollably at a friend's pregnan­cy...

programme.desc: Growing up in the Midwest in the early OOs, sixteen-year-old Alice has always been a good Catholic. programme.title: Astrud Gilberto & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: Gilberto, Gillespie & Skymasters - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, Dutch big band The Skymasters accompanied monumental jazz trumpet legend Dizzy Gillespie and the Brazilian bossa nova singer Astrud Gilberto at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Michael Mossman
programme.sub-title: Munich Philharmonic Hall: Michel Camilo Quintet
programme.desc: Well-known for his exuberant style and intimate familiarity with a vast range of jazz and Latin idioms, Michel Camilo has always had a sixth sense for musical adventure. Camilo was one of the most stimulating jazz pianists to emerge in the mid- to late '80s. His powerful two-handed attack (full of impressive technical skills), his knowledge of both jazz and Afro-Cuban music, and his willingness to constantly take chances turn each of his solos into an adventure. This broadcast was taped during the 1991 Münchner Klaviersommer, when Camilo was playing with his amazing Quintet. He is accompanied by Ned Mann (bass), Cliff Almond (drums), Michel Mossman (trumpet and trombone) and Ralph Bowen (saxophone and flute). Camilo's rise to fame has been swift, and his influences range from jazz musicians like Art Tatum and Keith Jarrett to twentieth-century composers like Debussy and Ravel.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival. Zawinul performed on a huge synthesizer outfit in this concert, recorded live at the Kongressaal in Munich, Germany.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6 and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Jihye Kim, Johan Karlström & Christine Nonbo Andersen
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2019.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Johnny Cash
programme.desc: Johnny Cash was one of the most influential figures in American music in the post war period. He managed to combine elements of folk, rock 'n' roll and country, which together with his distinctive voice and guitar style, created an instantly recognisable sound. 1994 was to prove to be Cash's only appearance at the Montreux Festival. The "Man In Black" had just released his acclaimed American Recordings album and his European tour took in Montreux on July 5. This classic concert features a number of tracks from his new album coupled with favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk The Line, Ghost Riders In The Sky, Orange Blossom Special and San Quentin. An added bonus is the guest appearance of his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks. Caught at one of the high points of his distinguished career this is truly Johnny Cash at his best.

programme.title: Carlos Santana
programme.desc: With a momentous career stretching back into the sixties, Santana has led the way in introducing initially Latin rhythms and styles and later influences from worldly cultures into the world of mainstream rock music. Along the way they have collected numerous awards, accrued multi-million album sales and garnered a string of top hit singles. Masterfully filmed in Montreux, Switzerland in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classic tracks from early hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" through to their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". This is undoubtedly the have-to-have definitive Santana live concert. Music video by Carlos Santana __© 2011 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: The Police
programme.desc: Around The World follows The Police on their first world tour in 1979 and 1980, as they visit 6 continents building their fanbase show-by-show, country-by-country, song-by-song. In between the performances, the film offers a jovial glimpse of the band as they travel around the world and their visits to local sights. Around The World is presented with restored picture and remastered audio, and includes complete performances of 4 songs featured in the documentary.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland
programme.desc: Flying Over Iceland: Part I is a stunning yet soothing aerial journey to the remote fjiords and valleys of eastern Iceland. The first of a series of 1 hour films, Part I begins at sunrise on a perfect summer day in Breiðdalsvík, where a golden sun lights up the majestic valley. After soaring through the golden sea mists and offering a glimpse of the stunning Breiðdalur Valley (its name means ‘Wide Valley'), viewers then head inland to a hidden, magical arched waterfall for a refreshing immersive flight that begins at the base of the falls and reaches above the clouds. Next, as the morning turns into a sunlit afternoon, viewers are swept inland to the crystal clear waters of the the impressive Breiðdalsá river, to cool off in some falls along with a pair of local swans. Well known for salmon fishing, the turquoise blue river winds its way scenically across the valley basin to the sea, which is where the film ends - but not before a chance encounter with a local reindeer! The final flight in Part 1 offers a sunny afternoon look at the tiny village of Breiðdalsvík from afar and offers amazing blue water vistas of with green islands, seagulls, a rock island that that looks like a cat, a scenic lighthouse, and more.

programme.title: Anatomía De Un Engaño
programme.desc: Genna Grey es una fiscal que lleva el caso de un asesino de mujeres en serie. Cuando es propuesta para alcaldesa de la ciudad, su vida empieza a sufrir amenazas hasta del director de policía.

programme.title: Paris, Wine and Romance
programme.desc: Isabella, la propietaria de la bodega familiar de Oregon, da un gran salto y participa en una prestigiosa competencia de vinos en París. Allí conoce a su mayor competidor, Jacques, de una de las familias vitivinícolas más importantes del mundo.

programme.title: Yo, gran cazador
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su mentor por parte de los indios, Pike decide vengarse y emprende la búsqueda del asesino que mató a su compañero. Pero en su camino se cruza un majestuoso caballo blanco.

programme.title: Pina (V.O.)
programme.desc: Homenaje de Wim Wenders en 3-D a la bailarina y coreógrafa alemana Pina Bausch, maestra de la danza, en un documental que recoge principalmente los testimonios de sus colaboradores.

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: 1919. La Gran Guerra ha acabado y el Café Rotonde se ha convertido en el refugio de la élite artística: Picasso, Rivera, Stein, Cocteau, Soutine, Modigliani... Esta es la historia jamás contada de la ácida rivalidad entre Picasso y Modigliani, marcada por la genialidad, la arrogancia y las pasiones. Jeanne Hébuterne es una bella católica, cuyo error fue enamorarse de Modigliani, un judío. Tratando de sacar a su familia de la pobreza, el artista se inscribe en el certamen anual de arte y Picasso, guiado por esa rivalidad, hará lo mismo.

programme.title: Mister Johnson
programme.desc: África, 1923. En la Nigeria colonial británica, el señor Johnson es una rareza, un hombre negro educado que realmente no encaja con los nativos ni con los británicos. Trabaja para la administración británica y se considera inglés, aunque nunca ha estado en Inglaterra. Su elevado nivel de educación e interés por integrarse en la sociedad blanca le traerán más de un problema.

programme.title: La Mirada
programme.desc: Una dramaturga que comienza a desmoronarse mentalmente no sabe decidir si es el centro de una trama manipuladora o si simplemente está perdiendo el contacto con la realidad.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película cuenta cómo un perro recorre Australia creando vínculos con los habitantes de un pueblo minero, convirtiéndose en un símbolo de amistad y lealtad.

programme.title: 3 generaciones
programme.desc: Ray es un adolescente transgénero que quiere comenzar su transición. Su madre debe localizar al padre biológico para obtener el consentimiento legal necesario. Mientras tanto, tres generaciones de la familia afrontan sus dudas, miedos y prejuicios hasta aprender a aceptarse mutuamente.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: En un pequeño pueblo francés, un panadero aficionado a la literatura se obsesiona con su vecina Gemma, cuya vida comienza a parecerse cada vez más a la famosa novela de Flaubert.

programme.title: Un Hombre Solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo venido a menos intenta superar tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera.

programme.title: Verano
programme.desc: Fragmentos de un día de verano.

programme.title: Ya te extraño
programme.desc: Amistad femenina enfrenta cáncer y embarazo.

programme.title: Oficina Zombie
programme.desc: Un empleado de una fábrica descubre que una bebida energética convierte a sus compañeros en zombis.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling es el protagonista de esta película, ya convertida en obra de culto y auténtica revelación del 2011, sobre un fascinante personaje que trabaja como conductor especialista de cine por el día y como conductor de atracos por la noche.

programme.title: Ojos que te acechan
programme.desc: "El Ojo" es un agente especial del Servicio Británico, cuya misión es seguir a Joanna Eris, una mujer sospechosa de chantajear a un miembro del gobierno.

programme.title: Las ocho montañas
programme.desc: Pietro es un chico de ciudad. Todos los años pasa el verano con su familia en el pueblo de Bruno, el último niño de una localidad de montaña olvidada. Con el paso de los años, Bruno se mantiene fiel a su montaña, mientras que Pietro viene y va.

programme.title: La Gran Apuesta
programme.desc: Basada en la historia real de 4 desconocidos que vieron lo que rechazaron los grandes bancos y el gobierno: el derrumbamiento mundial de la economía.

programme.title: El retrato de Dorian Gray
programme.desc: Dorian Gray es un atractivo aristócrata que regresa a Londres tras pasar la adolescencia aislado en el campo. Pronto comienza a obsesionarse con alcanzar la eterna juventud. A diferencia del resto, Dorian permanece impasible al sucederse los años...

programme.title: El profesor de Persa
programme.desc: Francia, 1942. Gilles es arrestado por soldados de las SS junto con otros judíos y enviado a un campo de concentración en Alemania. allí consigue evitar la ejecución al jurar a los guardias que no es judío, sino persa.

programme.title: Big Eyes
programme.desc: 'Big Eyes' está basada en la historia real de Walter Keane, uno de los pintores más exitosos de los años 50. El artista alcanzó una notoriedad asombrosa con sus enigmáticas pinturas de niños abandonados con grandes ojos. La autora era Margaret, su mujer, pero en realidad los firmaba Walter.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, narra como en la Irlanda de los años cincuenta la pequeña Evelyn y sus dos hermanos son separados y enviados a distintos orfanatos católicos, cuando un tribunal decide que su padre es incapaz de cuidar de ellos.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos atrapados en un bucle temporal.

programme.title: Todo es relativo
programme.desc: Harry ama a Grace, pero un secreto familiar convierte su historia de amor en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Fuerza Bruta
programme.desc: La reportera recién despedida Sloane Sawyer regresa de mala gana a su ciudad natal rural de California para investigar el acoso de los trabajadores de los viñedos locales y descorcha una maraña de delincuencia y corrupción detrás de la brillante fachada de la región vinícola.

programme.title: Dime con cuántos
programme.desc: La vida amorosa de Ally Darling (Anna Faris) es un desastre. Mientras intenta desesperadamente encontrar un acompañante para asistir a la boda de su hermana, conoce a Colin Shea (Chris Evans), un atractivo joven que huye de su novia. Entre ambos se establece una extraña conexión...

programme.title: Algún día nos lo contaremos todo
programme.desc: Verano de 1990, antigua Alemania Oriental. María está a punto de cumplir 19 años y vive en la granja de los padres de su novio Johannes...

programme.title: La lectora
programme.desc: Un novelista ciego tras un accidente de coche en el que también falleció su mujer, redescubre su pasión perdida por la vida y la escritura cuando comienza un romance con la mujer de un hombre de negocios condenado.

programme.title: Campeón de campeones (Chok Dee)
programme.desc: Ryan, un delincuente de poca monta, acaba en prisión. Allí conoce a Jean, un antiguo campeón de boxeo, quien le adentra en uno...

programme.title: Éxito a cualquier precio
programme.desc: Narra las ajetreadas vidas de unos agentes inmobiliarios de Chicago que intentan sobrevivir en un mundo altamente competitivo y un mercado en plena depresión. A pesar de la situación, reaccionan siempre con unos escrúpulos y una solidaridad admirables.

programme.title: Iron Sky
programme.desc: A finales de la Segunda Guerra Mundial un grupo de científicos nazis lanzó un cohete en dirección a la cara oculta de la Luna…

programme.title: Quiero ser italiano
programme.desc: Dino Fabrizzi es el vendedor número 1 de Maserati en Niza. A la edad de 42 años, está a punto de ser ascendido en su trabajo y su novia quiere casarse con él. La vida es magnífica para Dino. Pero esta vida perfecta está basada en una mentira. El verdadero nombre de Dino es Mourad Ben Saoud, un dato que mantiene en secreto de su jefe e incluso de su novia. Excepcionalmente Mourad deberá cumplir el Ramadán para honrar una promesa hecha a su padre enfermo... y no va a ser fácil disimularlo.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Diferencias irreconciliables
programme.desc: Una niña precoz exige la emancipación de sus padres, sorprendiéndolos a ambos.

programme.title: Igelak
programme.desc: Pello decide huir y cambiar de identidad, pero acaba viviendo en un edificio okupa.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Si fuéramos los últimos
programme.desc: A la deriva en su averiado transbordador espacial y con pocas esperanzas de ser rescatados, dos astronautas discuten si es mejor pasar los días que les quedan como amigos o algo más. El roce hace el cariño y las chispas cada vez van más en aumento…

programme.title: Mi mejor amigo gay
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes, Michael y Matty, han sido amigos desde 3o de primaria. Aún vírgenes, hacen un pacto para perder la virginidad antes de su graduación, pero su amistad se pondrá a prueba, cuando uno de ellos sale del armario...

programme.title: La Segunda Oportunidad (As They Made Us)
programme.desc: Una madre divorciada intenta hacer las paces con su disfuncional familia encontrando una segunda oportunidad en el amor.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: Novio Por Una Noche
programme.desc: A los diez años, Chuck (Dane Cook) rompió la regla básica del juego de la botella al negarse a besar a una chica gótica demente. Destrozada por su cruel rechazo y decidida a asegurarse que Chuck no encuentre nunca el amor verdadero, la vengativa chica le echa un maleficio al cobarde tramposo que lo persigue hasta su vida adulta. Veinte años después, Chuck es un dentista de éxito que no consigue mantener una relación estable. Un día, mientras asiste a la boda de una ex novia, Chuck se da cuenta de que todas las chicas con las que ha salido encontraron el amor verdadero con el siguiente hombre al que conocieron. Cuando se extiende el rumor de que Chuck es una especie de amuleto de la suerte para las mujeres que quieren casarse, todas las chicas a 150 kilómetros a la redonda empiezan a buscarlo para rollos de una noche Chuck no tarda en percatarse de lo vacío que puede ser el sexo sin amor verdadero. Al conocer a Cam (Jessica Alba), Chuck empieza a sospechar que ha encontrado a la mujer de sus sueños, ¿pero que será de su relación si Chuck y Cam duermen juntos? Ahora, para asegurarse de que Cam no acabe con el siguiente hombre al que conozca, Chuck por fin intentará romper la maldición que lo ha perseguido desde la niñez.

programme.title: Sex Tape Algo Pasa En La Nube
programme.desc: Cuando Jay (Jason Segel) y Annie (Cameron Diaz) comenzaron su relación, la atracción entre ambos era muy intensa. Diez años y dos hijos después, se dan cuenta de que hay que reavivar la llama de la pasión. Deciden entonces grabarse en vídeo mientras mantienen una maratoniana sesión sexual de tres horas. El problema surge cuando descubren que el vídeo ha sido enviado por error a sus amigos y familiares.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Operación Africa
programme.desc: África es el lugar donde Ace está en el caso, y se propone rescatar a un animal que detesta: ¡un murciélago! Jim Carrey vuelve a interpretar al detective de mascotas que lucha contra los caimanes, llama a los elefantes, brilla con los monos, lanza loogies, cruza carbones encendidos y domina los disfraces. Si estás preparado para reír como una manada de hienas, si quieres más diversión que un barril de monos de tamaño industrial, ya sabes lo que tienes que hacer. Atiende a la llamada.

programme.title: Solo Tu
programme.desc: Faith cree que el destino de su vida es unirse a un hombre llamado Damon Bradley. Años después, cuando está a punto de casarse con otra persona, tiene la oportunidad de encontrarse con el hombre que ella espera.

programme.title: Sitting Bull: Casta de guerreros
programme.desc: Sitting Bull, líder de los Sioux, se ve obligado por el general Custer a reaccionar violentamente, lo que lleva a la famosa batalla en Little Bighorn. Parrish, un amigo de los Sioux, intenta evitar la sangre derramada pero es acusado de colaborar con el enemigo. Sitting Bull intercede ante el presidente Grant para salvarlo.

programme.title: El tesoro del lago de plata
programme.desc: Tras el asalto a una diligencia y el asesinato de su padre, Fred Engel se une a Old Shatterhand y Winnetou para recuperar un mapa del tesoro dividido en dos. Su búsqueda los lleva hasta Silver Lake, donde deberán adelantarse a la banda del coronel Brinkley, decidida a hacerse con el oro.

programme.title: Los apuros de dos gallos
programme.desc: Dos estafadores se ensañan con la economía local de un pequeño pueblo que visitan... pero luego se enamoran de dos jóvenes emparentadas con los ricos terratenientes que son el objetivo de su principal estafa.

programme.title: La fiebre de la pradera
programme.desc: Un grupo de mujeres contrae una extraña fiebre y un antiguo sheriff se encarga de llevarlas al hospital de la ciudad más cercana, pero en su camino se encontrarán con una peligrosa banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Dossier K.
programme.desc: Vincke y Verstuyft son detectives del departamento de policía de Amberes. Esta vez tienen que lidiar con la mafia albanesa y con algunos problemas en su propia división de la policía.

programme.title: Jinetes Espirituales
programme.desc: Cuando una adolescente rebelde es arrestada y condenada a un campamento de equinoterapia, establece una conexión con un enérgico pura sangre al que ayuda a entrenar con la orientación del dueño del rancho.

programme.title: Yo te quiero más
programme.desc: Neycy, joven cubana con sueños rotos, emigra hacia México en busca de libertad, pero cae en las redes de Mario, quien la explota bajo falsas promesas. Entre miseria y dignidad, lucha por cumplir sus sueños. Nueva producción de Andariego Films con Producciones Parabolum.

programme.title: Una Navidad en familia
programme.desc: Aiden, un niño prodigio de 10 años, quiere unir a su familia, siempre en conflicto. Para la feria científica intenta crear un experimento que los acerque, y termina invocando a un espíritu navideño olvidado. La magia provoca que los hermanos intercambien cuerpos y deban colaborar para romper el hechizo antes de Navidad.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Éternité
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, Valentine, de 20 años, se casa con Jules. Cien años más tarde, su nieta recorre un puente en París para encontrarse con el hombre que ama. Durante el siglo que las separa, hombres y mujeres se conocen, se enamoran y cruzan sus destinos, creando un árbol genealógico y una fuerza vital que continuará para la eternidad…

programme.title: Fly
programme.desc: Bex, una joven convicta, se une a un programa de rehabilitación social en la cárcel para lidiar con el doloroso trauma de su crimen. La dura líder del grupo, Ava, intenta encauzar a estos jóvenes por medio de una pasión común: el baile.

programme.title: La abeja Maya. La película
programme.desc: La curiosa abeja Maya y su amigo Willy salvarán a la colmena de la avaricia del consejero de la reina y pondrán fin a años de hostilidad entre abejas y avispas. Maya es una abeja recién nacida muy vivaracha que no sigue las reglas de la colmena, entre ellas la de no confiar en las avispas que viven más allá de la pradera. Cuando desaparece la jalea real, las avispas son las principales sospechosas y las abejas señalan a Maya como cómplice del robo. Ninguna de sus compañeras cree en su inocencia y Willy, su mejor amigo, será su único apoyo. Juntos se embarcarán en un largo viaje lleno de aventuras hasta la colmena de las avispas para encontrar al verdadero culpable. Gracias a Maya y Willy por fin reinará la amistad entre todos los residentes de la opulenta pradera.

programme.title: Visitante
programme.desc: Marga, en medio de una crisis con su marido, decide pasar unos días en una antigua casa de su pueblo. Allí, empieza a percibir extraños fenómenos que la aterran.

programme.title: Amateurs
programme.desc: Marsella (Francia): El día que Blanca cumple 16 años, su madre muere sepultada bajo tres toneladas de pescado, quedando sola en la vida. Vallecas (Madrid): Julio Nieves, un fornido capataz de la construcción de 65 años, cae desplomado en su ducha. A partir de ahora se enfrenta a su dura jubilación.

programme.title: Marquise
programme.desc: Marquise seduce a René, el actor principal del grupo de teatro de Molière. Él pide su mano y ella acepta, con la condición de que la dejen entrar en el grupo de teatro, pero su talento no está a la altura de su belleza. Más tarde llega Jean Racine, que se enamora de ella....

programme.title: Amalia en el otoño
programme.desc: Isabel está preocupada por su madre Amalia, en una residencia.. Poco después, la COVID-19 aparece en la vida de todos.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era
programme.desc: Este film narra tres historias de amor urbanas. Álex y Lucía se encuentran, empiezan a conocerse y entre ellos surge un romance. Paz y Jorge ven impotentes cómo su relación se apaga sin saber qué hacer. Finalmente, Albert e Irene vuelven a verse tras varios decenios de separación.

programme.title: 2 Palomas
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario amoral y grasiento es presa de una de sus victimas, que se muda silenciosamente a su apartamento y, sin ser visto, comienza una deliciosa y maliciosa campana de venganza. Two Pigeons es una comedia negra con una vena siniestra.

programme.title: 2 Palomas
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario amoral y grasiento es presa de una de sus victimas, que se muda silenciosamente a su apartamento y, sin ser visto, comienza una deliciosa y maliciosa campana de venganza. Two Pigeons es una comedia negra con una vena siniestra.

programme.title: The Ungodly
programme.desc: Mickey is about to get his big break as an amateur filmmaker, from a serial killer who turns him and his camera into "the perfect witness".

programme.title: Billy The Kid Versus Dracula
programme.desc: Dracula travels to the American West, intent on making a beautiful ranch owner his next victim. Her fiance, outlaw Billy the Kid, finds out about it and rushes to save her.

programme.title: Vampire Circus
programme.desc: As the plague sweeps the countryside, a quarantined village is visited by a mysterious traveling circus. Soon, young children begin to disappear, and the locals suspect the circus troupe might be hiding a horrifying secret.

programme.title: Psychomania
programme.desc: A gang of young people call themselves the Living Dead. They terrorize the population from their small town. After an agreement with the devil, if they kill themselves firmly believing in it, they will survive and gain eternal life. Following their leader, they commit suicide one after the other, but things don't necessarily turn out as expected.

programme.title: Asalto al Cine
programme.desc: Unos jóvenes en México planean un atraco a un cine, sin saber que sus vidas van a cambiar drásticamente tras el crimen.

programme.title: Blackjack
programme.desc: Dolph Lundgren interpreta a Jack Devlin, un U.S Marshal que protege a clientes de alto perfil cuando se trata de una cuestión de seguridad.

programme.title: San Andreas Mega Seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos hacen un horrible descubrimiento: El "Big One" se acerca en dos días, con él, California se hundirá en el océano. Su única esperanza es romper un volcán que desplace la energía del terremoto y construya una nueva corteza en la superficie. Pero a medida que las pretemblores convierten California en un caos, se trata de una carrera contrarreloj que los científicos podrían no ganar

programme.title: Cuestion de Honor
programme.desc: Un Ranger del Ejército se infiltra en una familia mafiosa haciéndose pasar por asesino a sueldo. Junto con su tío, traman una venganza contra los asesinos que mataron a toda su familia cuando él era joven.

programme.title: Viking
programme.desc: Finales del s. X. Tras la muerte de su padre Sviatoslav I, el joven príncipe vikingo Vladimir de Nóvgorod se ve obligado a exiliarse en el mar helado para escapar de su hermanastro traidor Yaropolk, que ha asesinado a su otro hermano Oleg y conquistado el territorio vikingo de la Rus de Kiev.

programme.title: El virtuoso
programme.desc: Thriller de acción con Anthony Hopkins. Virtuoso es un solitario asesino a sueldo que debe eliminar a su último objetivo para satisfacer una deuda pero la única información que tiene es un lugar y una hora.

programme.title: La Jungla
programme.desc: Jungle está basada en la historia real de Yossi Ghinsberg, un aventurero que sobrevivió para escribir un bestseller de memorias sobre su aventura en el interior del Amazonas. El viaje de Yossi y sus amigos acabó convirtiéndose en un calvario tan aterrador como psicológico.

programme.title: Valentine, venganza oscura
programme.desc: La tranquila ciudad de Batavia ya no es lo que era. La violencia, los robos y la gran tasa de criminalidad hacen de sus calles un lugar inhabitable. En medio de ese caos vive Srimaya, una joven aspirante a actriz que, acabará convirtiéndose en una superheroína para acabar con el crimen de la ciudad.

programme.title: El Cobrador De Deudas 2
programme.desc: Dos cobradores de deudas huyen de un mafioso mientras intentan atrapar a varios criminales.

programme.title: En Primera Línea
programme.desc: En 1968, un equipo en Vietnam enfrenta tensiones raciales, crisis morales y el peso de la guerra.

programme.title: Hombres Muertos
programme.desc: En el Oeste, dos hermanos buscan vengar a su padre, proteger a los apaches y recuperar sus tierras.

programme.title: Aún sé lo que hicisteis el último verano
programme.desc: Un año después de ser acosada por Ben Willis, la víctima mortal de un accidente en el que ella estuvo implicada junto a sus amigos, Julie ha dejado su ciudad natal para ir a la Universidad. Una extraña llamada le anuncia que es la ganadora de un fin de semana en una isla paradisiaca, lugar en el que la pesadilla vuelve a repetirse.

programme.title: Christine
programme.desc: La retorcida historia de amor de un adolescente y su celoso Plymouth Fury modelo 58.

programme.title: Anaconda 4: Rastro De Sangre
programme.desc: Una cría de anaconda, genéticamente mejorada, se ha regenerado y crece monstruosamente. La cría sedienta de sangre es aparentemente invencible, y se desliza entre explosiones y disparos para regenerarse y alimentarse insaciablemente de todo lo que se encuentre en su camino.

programme.title: Anaconda 3: La Amenaza
programme.desc: En un centro de investigación en un bosque europeo, un brillante científico está realizando esperimentos con dos colosales serpientes. Pero cuando el hombre de negocios que financia todo, lleva el experimento demasiado lejos, las serpientes escapan, hambrientas y dirigiéndose hacia la civilización.
